basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Lifelong Learning (CLL), School of Social Work, Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, has invited applications for 1 Intern to support the organisation and coordination of a Seminar. The stipend is Rs 10,000/- per month for an internship of 05 months. Applicants need a Master's degree in Social Work/ Social Sciences/ Psychology/ Education/Economics/Demography and at least 1 year of work experience in organizing International Conferences. Only local/Mumbai-based candidates can apply. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 16 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Write a letter of interest of not more than 350 words answering the question: What drives your interest in working for this project?
Send both by email to [email protected].
Write the subject line "Application for the Internship Position".
Make sure the application is received by 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: TISS Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai
Centre for Lifelong Learning (CLL), School of Social Work

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its address in the notice is V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088. This internship sits in the Centre for Lifelong Learning, School of Social Work, and the Project Leader is Dr. Saigita Chitturu.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice sets one essential qualification and two skill requirements for the single Intern post. Education: a Master's degree in Social Work/ Social Sciences/ Psychology/ Education/Economics/Demography. Experience: at least 1 year of work experience in organizing International Conferences. Skills: strong written and oral communication skills in English, and proficiency in the use of computers. Residence: only local/Mumbai-based candidates can apply. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend is Rs 10,000/- per month. The duration of the internship is 05 months. The notice prints the tenure as 1st December 2026 to 30th April, 2026. It does not mention any allowance in addition to the stipend.

content_sections.heading: TISS Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Managing day to day work related to the Seminar Managing logistics of the Seminar Coordinating and liaising with TISS various departments Compendium preparation Research Work/Analysis Accounts work

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Intern
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated Resume/CV. Write a letter of interest of not more than 350 words answering the question: What drives your interest in working for this project? Send both by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line "Application for the Internship Position". Make sure the application is received by 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview through phone and/or email. The notice does not mention the interview date, venue or any other selection stage.
